name: Itsuki Shiori
source:
Takeru's childhood friend and the only daughter of the Itsuki family, where he's staying. She's in the same class as Takeru. Her personality matches her appearance—bright and easygoing, yet strong-willed at heart. She belongs to the Occult and Mysticism Research Club, where Satoko serves as president.

[Translated from [url=https://www.xuse.co.jp/product/048_kuon-s/]link[/url]]
